correctness.rationale: For fixed residual complements \(D\) and \(R\) there are exactly \((n-2d)!\) admissible partial injections, so \(D^\rho\) and \(R^\rho\) are independent uniform subsets of sizes \(2d+1\) and \(2d\). If the leaf-label set \(S\) misses \(D^\rho\times R^\rho\), then every design leads to an erroneous output. Counting such rectangles gives the exact biclique-density lower bound; a union bound, the \(p^e\) leaf bound, and the definition of the Zarankiewicz number yield the stated consequences. All quantifiers and boundary cases are explicit.
